audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[0..6].side is a blanket 'Skill' on every row while content win[0..6], every whys/spikes string, and early/mid/late all say Xerath wins the entire matchup. The packet itself flags this as a defect: 'level chart contradicts data: Tahm Kench wins 54.73% but the chart gives Xerath 7/7 stages vs 0'.
audit.why: Note the packet defect is about the overall win-rate stat vs. the chart, not evidence the chart is wrong — Tahm Kench's 54.73% win rate is a full-game/priority stat, while the level chart tracks who wins each individual laning stage, and content's per-stage prose (Q outranges, W-into-E stun, global R zoning) consistently and specifically supports Xerath winning every laning stage before TK's kit and tank stats take over post-lane. The full layer's blanket 'Skill' is the generic even-matchup template, contradicted by its own diffRating (7/10 Tricky) and carryRating (7.5/10) on the same page.
audit.corrected: Flipped phases[0..6].side to Xerath to match win[0..6] (already Xerath, so no content edit needed per the chart rule) and rewrote each phases[N].why to state the specific Xerath interaction from the kit (Arcanopulse range, Eye of Destruction slow into Shocking Orb stun, global Rite of the Arcane zoning, Luden's scaling, late artillery range) instead of the generic Skill-chart filler.

audit.why: Content spikes correctly key to level 2 (Q+W combo), level 6 (global R zoning), first item (Luden's burst), and late (full-artillery range denial).

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d are verbatim tradeGood/tradeBad text pasted under unrelated titles (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED); breakdown.cooldowns has no digit; missingInteractions flags that Xerath's R (Rite of the Arcane) is an interruptible channel and Tahm Kench's Q stun cancels it outright, which the page never states.
audit.why: dosFull[1].t promises advice about devouring the all-in's focus and dontsFull[2].t promises advice about Q-ing chip instead of diving, but neither body says anything specific to its own title; breakdown.cooldowns names Shocking Orb as matchup-defining with no actual cooldown number; the Q-cancels-R interaction is the single highest-value counterplay in this matchup and is completely absent from the page.
audit.corrected: Rewrote dosFull[1].d to state the Q-cancels-R interaction (Tahm Kench's Q applies hardCC, which interrupts Xerath's channeled ultimate), rewrote dontsFull[2].d to match its own title, and added Shocking Orb's real cooldown (13s at rank 1, down to 11s) plus R's 130/115/100s to breakdown.cooldowns.
